question: What does "superficial" mean in this passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2)** i.e. Focusing only on surface appearance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Superficial** means existing or occurring at or on the surface level, focusing only on appearance rather than on deeper aspects or details. It implies a lack of depth and thoroughness. (केवल सतही दिखावट पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His understanding of the subject was superficial, only concerned with basic facts and appearances.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Focusing only on surface appearance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Deep and thoughtful** (गहन और विचारशील):

 
 
• This phrase means an in-depth and reflective approach or thinking.
 
• **Example: **Her analysis of the poem was deep and thoughtful.
 
 
 
• **Natural beauty** (प्राकृतिक सुंदरता):
 
 
• This phrase refers to beauty that is inherent and not artificial or enhanced.
 
• **Example: **The natural beauty of the landscape was breathtaking.
 
 
 
• **Healthy lifestyle** (स्वस्थ जीवन शैली):
 
 
• This phrase means living in a way that promotes physical and mental well-being.
 
• **Example: **Eating balanced meals and exercising regularly are part of a healthy lifestyle.
 
 

48:Tbbf,

The correct answer is: **Option (3)** i.e. An intense and unhealthy focus.
